jobs.description:

HETI has a great opportunity for a Senior Geologist/Senior Environmental Scientist/Senior Engineer with 10+ years’ experience in the environmental field.

This role will be responsible for providing technical and business skills and contribute to advanced solutions in the environmental, chemical, commercial, manufacturing, government, energy, financial, insurance, and/or legal sectors. This job is 100% remote.

The candidate should have experience managing consulting assignments, must work effectively in multi-disciplinary teams, is expected to be proficient in the analysis and communication of information, and must be able to work cooperatively with agencies, organizations, and individuals to guide decision-making. The successful candidate is also expected to be proficient in all facets of project management. He/she must demonstrate collaboration with colleagues throughout the organization.

Key Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Client Management & Communication:

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status and outcomes.
Collaborate with project teams, including environmental engineers, geologists, and technicians.
Communicate complex technical information to clients and stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

Regulatory Compliance & Reporting:

Interact and coordinate with regulatory agencies to obtain necessary approvals, permits, and closure documentation.
Prepare and submit comprehensive reports, including site investigation reports, risk assessment reports, remedial action plans, progress reports, and closure reports.
Be current and continue to be current on environmental regulations and guidelines.

Remediation Planning/Implementation:

Develop and implement effective remediation plans based on the findings of site investigations and risk assessments.
Design and oversee the implementation of remediation strategies, which may include excavation, soil vapor extraction, groundwater treatment, in-situ bioremediation, or other appropriate methods.
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations, guidelines, and permits during the remediation process.

Insurance Claim Support

Experience providing technical support to insurance claims professionals for environmental or energy related claims.
Understanding of insurance terminology and policy language.
Experience in assessing the source and timing of pollution events.
Diverse environmental consulting experience.
Excellent technical writing skills.

Site Assessments:

Manage/conduct comprehensive site investigations to identify potential sources of contamination, evaluate risks, and develop appropriate remediation strategies.
Collect soil, groundwater, and other environmental samples and analyze them in accordance with standard protocols and regulations.
Perform data interpretation, risk assessment, and modeling to determine the extent and nature of contamination and its potential impact on human health and the environment.

Quality Control:

Implement quality control and assurance measures to ensure accurate and reliable data collection, analysis, and reporting.
Conduct periodic audits and reviews of project activities to verify compliance with project plans and regulations.
Identify and address any deviations or discrepancies in project execution promptly.

The Ideal Candidate should have:

Current PE or PG license
Bachelor’s Degree in environmental science, geology, engineering, or a related field.
10+ years’ experience conducting site investigations remediation and third party evaluations
Solid understanding of environmental regulations, guidelines, and best practices related to contaminated site cleanup.
Excellent project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, regulatory agencies, and project teams.
Attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Knowledge of environmental sampling techniques and laboratory analysis methods.

Founded in 1986, HETI is a full-service, nationwide environmental services company specializing in environmental and indoor air quality site assessment, site remediation, risk characterization, occupational health and safety services, and litigation/expert witness support. Through our network of offices throughout the U.S., we serve a variety of large and small businesses.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and offer a competitive benefit package including base salary plus bonus opportunities and a friendly, flexible work environment.

Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses (https://www.idexcorp.com/our-businesses/business-segments/) around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

JOB TITLE:
Finance Data & Transformation Analyst

REPORTING TO:
Finance Manager, IH&S

LOCATION:
Remote

Who is IDEX Health & Science (IH&S)?

As a business unit of IDEX Corporation, IH&S has a long history of driving growth in life sciences and healthcare by embracing innovation and redefining the supplier-customer relationship. The work we do every day allows us to discover key insights and break new ground to create some of the most meaningful technologies that have a lasting impact on companies, industries, and society. One of business segments is called Life Science Fluidics and we are looking to add more talent to the team.

IDEX Health & Science (IH&S)

IH&S is comprised of six domestic and one international business unit. IH&S is a manufacturing and R&D focused team that sits at the leading edge of high-end fluidic and optical applications for life sciences. Focused on assisting partners at every stage of the development processes, we invest in people and infrastructure to drive bold ideas and pragmatic solutions. With the rich foundation of talent, universities, and supporting businesses, IH&S is the ideal location to elevate your career with fascinating work and endless opportunities.

Our formula for success is simple. We work hard to maintain a culture where you can own your work; you are encouraged to try new ideas in a collaborative environment; and you can apply your skillset to enable our clients to gain a competitive advantage in their own market. At IDEX Health & Science, you will have the opportunity to work with a great group of people, mentor others, and build a great future.

Scope Of Role

This position plays a critical role in advancing IH&S’s finance data transformation initiatives by focusing on developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, enabling standardized financial reporting, and translating complex financial and operational data into clear, decision-ready insights. In addition to supporting ongoing reporting needs, this individual will contribute to the design and implementation of scalable data models that support forecasting, KPI tracking, and executive-level performance visibility. Working within an Agile framework, this role will prioritize enhancements and ensure delivery of high-impact analytics solutions that support business performance and strategic decision-making.

Essential Duties

Building data models and creating processes for monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting cycles, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of data
Analyze financial and operational data to identify ways to capture and report on trends, variances, risks, and opportunities, and present findings to finance leadership
Partner with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, IT, and Operations teams to ensure data consistency, and alignment between the tools (dashboards/reports) used for financial reporting and to monitor business performance drivers
Maintain and prioritize reporting and analytics backlogs leveraging the Agile framework.
Support executive-level reporting by creating clear, concise, and visually compelling dashboards and summaries.
Contribute to finance and business transformation initiatives, including automation of reporting processes and improvement of data accessibility and usability
Support various workflows by developing financial KPI calculation logic, creating PBI visuals for leadership consumption.
Support standardized reporting frameworks and ongoing transformation initiatives related to forecasting, reporting standardization, and data governance

Job Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field, with an emphasis in quantitative methods, statistical modeling, and data science.
3+ years of experience in financial analysis, business intelligence, or data analytics roles in a manufacturing financial environment.
Strong understanding of and experience with financial accounting concepts including financial reporting, cost accounting, FP&A. and KPI development
Understanding of ERP software is required, proficiency in JD Edwards is preferred.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology is preferred. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum outside of traditional software design is ideal.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into effective technical solutions.
Strong proficiency in Power BI, including DAX and data modeling.
Attention to detail, with consistent application of audit trails, versioning, and documented best practices.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organization.

TOTAL REWARDS (May Vary by State)

While the full compensation range for this role is listed below, our anticipated hiring range is $90,000-$105,000
. This projected range is an estimate and will vary based on each candidate’s experience and qualifications, so it is not a guaranteed offer amount. This position may also be eligible for a performance-based bonus plan.

This position is a remote role; however, we are seeking candidates who reside within reasonable proximity to an IDEX Health & Science (IH&S) location. While day‑to‑day work is performed remotely, occasional on‑site collaboration, training, or team events may be required. Applicants should be located close enough to commute to an IH&S facility when needed.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Role

The Data Analyst turns product, customer, and operational data into reliable reporting and clear business decisions. The role works across SQL-based warehouses such as Snowflake or BigQuery, BI tools such as Looker or Tableau, and modern transformation workflows built with dbt.

The analyst will partner with product, operations, finance, and engineering teams to define metrics, investigate performance trends, and improve the quality of dashboards and recurring analyses. This role matters because trustworthy data is essential to prioritizing product investments, identifying issues early, and measuring business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Write and optimize SQL queries across large relational datasets to answer business and product questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and self-service analyses in Looker, Tableau, or a comparable BI platform
Define and document metrics, dimensions, and source-of-truth logic in partnership with stakeholders and data engineers
Investigate data quality issues, reconcile discrepancies, and communicate findings with clear recommendations
Develop repeatable analysis workflows using Python, spreadsheets, or dbt to reduce manual reporting effort
Analyze trends in customer behavior, product usage, revenue, and operational performance to support planning and decision-making
Present analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences through concise written summaries and visualizations

What We Are Looking For

0–2 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics, or a closely related role, including internships or substantial project work
Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, aggregations, window functions, and basic query optimization
Hands-on experience with a BI or visualization tool such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or Mode
Working knowledge of Python or R for data cleaning, exploratory analysis, and repeatable reporting workflows
Understanding of analytical fundamentals, including metric design, cohort analysis, experiment interpretation, and data validation
Bachelor’s degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, business analytics, or a related quantitative field
Bonus: Experience with dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Git, or automated data quality testing

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

As a senior analyst in a well-funded, growth Series C start-up, you will be defining our growth potential for years to come. You will be an integral part of Reserv’s data team, working with our customers to deliver high-fidelity data and insights.

For this role, we are seeking data analysts with strong Python, SQL, and Excel skills. You should be curious about how claims work and how our systems process them. You’ll also need the ability to interface with customers from both technical and non-technical backgrounds, and to work independently while collaborating closely with our engineering and operations teams. If you are ready to help shape the vision for Reserv’s technology, join us on the journey.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

What You Will Do

Work with our data stack: Python (Pandas to NLTK), Postgres/dbt, Looker, Excel, etc.
Lead client calls through technical analysis to provide recommendations and insights
Ship reporting code and improve our data modeling layer to solve for our customers' needs
Work on problems that don’t have a clearly defined answer, often helping define the “right” solution
Communicate ideas and specifications through detailed, precise writing
Influence the culture, values, and processes of a growing engineering team
Enjoy and have fun being creative and thinking outside of the box. You will need to draw on analogous situations you’ve worked on before, but we are not traversing well-traveled roads. “Where we’re going, we don’t need roads!”

Qualifications

6-8 years of experience as an individual contributor with experience using modern analytics and programming languages—we’re in Python and dbt/Postgres every day
A proven ability to interface with high-value customers and communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences alike
Have a strong demonstrated toolkit to build ETLs and net new data visualizations/reports
Have a proven track record of shipping high quality data analysis at a high cadence
A passion for building intuitive technology and a thirst for learning
Able to think through customer requirements and prioritize what is a must-have, nice-to-have, or irrelevant
Have a strong technical skillset but also the willingness and ability to take over tasks outside your core competency

Benefits

Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

We are a leading environmental testing and consulting firm specializing in asbestos, mold, lead, indoor air quality and building science assessments. We help our clients identify, assess and resolve environmental hazards through expert investigation, analysis and regulatory-compliant solutions.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Environmental Scientist to lead environmental investigations involving mold, asbestos, lead, indoor air quality (IAQ), and other environmental hazards. This individual will serve as a technical subject matter expert responsible for developing sampling strategies, interpreting laboratory results, authoring technical reports, and designing remediation and asbestos abatement protocols. 

The ideal candidate is a highly technical environmental professional who can walk into a situation, ask the right questions, determine potential environmental concerns, develop appropriate testing protocol, interpret findings and clearly communicate recommendations to clients.

Conduct environmental assessments and investigations related to mold, asbestos, lead, indoor air quality, water damage, and other environmental concerns.
Develop site-specific testing and sampling protocols based on project conditions and client needs.
Interpret laboratory results and provide technical recommendations and remediation strategies.
Prepare detailed technical reports, risk assessments, and client deliverables.
Support complex property damage, contamination, and environmental exposure investigations.
Mentor junior staff and provide technical leadership with the opportunity to grow into a management role.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science or a related field.
10+ years of experience performing environmental consulting, testing, and assessment work.
Extensive experience with mold, asbestos, lead, indoor air quality, and environmental sampling methodologies.
Strong understanding of environmental regulations, investigation protocols, and remediation practices.
Exceptional technical writing and report development skills.
Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) credential preferred but not required.
Proven ability to evaluate unique environmental situations, identify potential hazards, and develop effective testing and investigation strategies.

Our values guide us, and our mission drives us. Come join us and help deliver financial wellness for the whole family, putting the tools of wealth-making into everyone’s hands.

Data Analyst I | Acorns

Acorns is seeking a Data Analyst I to serve as a key partner for our Core Experience team, specifically focused on our Investing and Banking product lines. In this role, you will leverage data to optimize the customer journey, working at the intersection of Product, Finance, and Operations to ensure our core features deliver maximum value to our customers. You will play a vital role in shaping the product roadmap by transforming raw data into actionable insights that drive retention and enhance the overall customer experience.

Acorns is a remote-first organization, offering the flexibility to work remotely while providing optional access to office space in Irvine, CA.

What You Will Do At Acorns

Collaborate with the Core Experience team to drive the ideation and rigorous analysis of product experiments.
Partner with Product, Finance, and Operations to build and maintain robust reports and dashboards specifically for our Core Experience product lines.
Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract data from various sources for deep-dive analysis.
Utilize Databricks and DBT to transform raw data into clean, accessible datasets for the broader team.
Design and manage intuitive Tableau dashboards that track key performance indicators (KPIs) for Investing and Banking features.
Monitor customer behavior and product performance using Amplitude to identify opportunities for friction reduction and growth.
Work with managers and cross-functional teams to establish priorities, including new infrastructure and tool building.

What You Will Bring To Acorns

3+ years of Analytics experience, preferably supporting product development or financial services.
Strong SQL skills for data extraction and experience with data visualization tools like Tableau.
A solid understanding of statistical concepts and hands-on experience of A/B testing methodologies and product experimentation.
Familiarity with modern data stack tools such as Databricks, DBT, and product analytics platforms like Amplitude.
The ability to translate complex numerical findings into clear, persuasive recommendations for non-technical stakeholders in Finance and Operations.
Hunger to deliver game-changing products.
Exceptional drive and precision in delivery.
A belief that your work is tied to your life's mission.
Optimistic about the potential of societal change.

You are not expected to have experience with all listed requirements. If you feel passionate about Acorns' mission, vision, and values, please apply.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and stock options
A comprehensive benefits package for you and your family
Flexible work location, hours, and paid time off
401(k) matching
Monthly Acorns account contribution & GoHenry account for your family
Mindfulness and Financial Wellness resources, Headspace and Addition Wealth
Acorns Career Development Program (Ongoing training sessions, development plans, development check-ins, Cornerstone’s online training platform)
Roots Leadership Program for Emerging Leaders
Community week onsite gatherings and various virtual events
Talented and motivated team members who care deeply about one another, our mission, and our customers.
The rare opportunity to create a new world. We inspire one another every day to do meaningful work that solves big societal challenges.

About Acorns

Acorns is the financial wellness company helping everyday Americans grow their money for the long term. Since 2014, Acorns has grown into a global company with multiple life stage products serving the needs of kids, teens, adults and parents. Named one of America's Best Financial Services of 2026 by TIME, Acorns has served over 16 million people, and helped customers save & invest over $33 billion dollars, much of it from spare change and small amounts.
